lastResponse.text: Fastest next step: call 5 0 3, 6 5 0, 5 6 2 2 now. Say only: “I need a domestic violence advocate, and I may need shelter or a ride tonight.” You don’t have to give details you don’t want to share. They can help you plan a quiet, safe move quickly. If that line doesn’t answer before your battery dies, call 9 1 1 if danger becomes immediate.
